suite_state_at_freeze.how: tools/gate_f/run_segment.sh wrote this record at launch and does not run the unit suite (~28 minutes). Whoever froze this candidate should replace this block with a real result before the run is read as evidence.
suite_state_at_freeze._comment: Protocol section A.4 makes a green suite a precondition of the run rather than a finding of it, and says the field exists so Phase B reads the actual state rather than an implied green. An honest 'not verified' is the actual state when a runner writes the record.
